question: In locations.csv, sum count_rate3 across all state-level rows (all rows except the national row with abbreviation US). By how much does this sum differ from the count_rate3 value reported in the US row (state sum minus US value)? Report an integer.
solve_py:
import os, pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
a=pd.read_csv(D+'/locations.csv',keep_default_na=False);u=a[a.abbreviation=='US'].count_rate3.iloc[0];print(int(a[a.abbreviation!='US'].count_rate3.sum()-u))
